subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft remain open only as a combined Mantis proof target until live Telegram evidence exists, or should maintainers choose a different boundary for the generated-media wake-false work?
rationale: The code path is plausible from source, but the PR is explicitly a draft proof stack and the available live proof did not start the scenario, so automation cannot decide the landing boundary or proof sufficiency.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until redacted Telegram Desktop proof or equivalent live logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Accept Combined Boundary
options.body: Merge the stack only if maintainers deliberately want the production fallback and proof harness to land together despite the stated split plan.

options.title: Close After Proof Purpose Ends
options.body: Close this draft once useful proof is captured or maintainers decide the proof runner cannot exercise this scenario.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until redacted Telegram Desktop proof or equivalent live logs show baseline missing/blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily about the Telegram/Mantis proof runner and recent history points to vincentkoc as the strongest proof-harness routing candidate.
